name: aws_governance_bridge
description: Read-only AWS infrastructure inspection tool, governed and audited via the ECC GovernanceContext. Every invocation must be tied to a correlation_id so cloud lookups remain traceable in telemetry.

governance.notes: Agents must obtain correlation_id from the active GovernanceContext and pass it explicitly. Do not fabricate or omit correlation_id when invoking this tool.

methods.name: inspect_infrastructure
methods.description: Performs a read-only lookup against AWS for the given resource_type and returns a normalized result. Logs an audit line before execution and on completion or failure.

resource_type.description: The category of AWS resource to inspect.

correlation_id.description: Must be sourced from the active GovernanceContext.correlation_id. The bridge raises ValueError if omitted or empty.

session.description: Optional pre-configured boto3.Session; defaults to boto3.Session() using the ambient AWS credential chain.

security.credential_handling: Uses the ambient boto3/AWS credential chain (environment, shared config, or instance/task role). This tool never accepts, stores, or logs raw AWS credentials.
security.mutating_actions: None. All mapped operations are read-only describe/list calls.
